subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A' and column
stimulus: 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B (a) A person is known (i) that he does not listen music. (b) I would lend him (ii) your body allows it. (c) He was so attentive (iii) by the company he keeps. (d) He was reading (iv) had I more books. with a view to (e) Work hard provided (v) that he got GPA 5.
guide_solution: Matching (a) + (iii) A person is known by the company he keeps. (b) + (iv) I would lend him had I more books. (c) + (i) He was so attentive that he does not listen to music. (d) + (vi) He was reading with a view to making a good result. (e) + (ii) Work hard provided that your body allows it.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 97 — Chittagong Govt. High School
